name: 2027 ACGME Annual Educational Conference
organizer: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education
description: The Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education holds its 2027 Annual Educational Conference in San Antonio, Texas. The conference covers graduate medical education, accreditation, and residency program administration.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: 5:00 pm Central time; one ACGME communication also mentioned August 26, which may refer to a different, earlier call, verify directly

sources.note: Confirms Feb 25 to 27, 2027, San Antonio, Texas, across multiple page sections, via search engine cache
Confirms Call for Abstracts opened August 17, 2026 with a submission portal close date of September 24, 2026

notes: One indexed ACGME e-communication snippet referenced Atlanta and the Georgia World Congress Center in the same context as a future Annual Educational Conference; at least seven independent official page snippets confirm San Antonio, Texas for the February 25 to 27, 2027 conference, so the Atlanta reference likely belongs to a different year (possibly 2028) and should be checked directly on acgme.org.
